title: Mixture-of-Experts Transformers
interviewAnswer: MoE layers route each token to a small subset of expert feed-forward networks, increasing total model capacity without activating all parameters per token.
why: MoE explains how some large models scale capacity more cheaply than dense models.
intuition: A router sends each token to only a few specialized sub-networks.
deepDive: Top-k routing reduces arithmetic but introduces load-balancing, expert-capacity and distributed communication problems.
commonMistakes: Assuming all MoE parameters run for every token.
production: MoE can become network-bound; topology and routing balance are system-design concerns.
workedExample: Different token types may statistically route to different experts, though expert semantics are not guaranteed.
